full_prompt_en: A square mixed-media drawing shows the head and shoulders of a young woman emerging from a pale, weathered paper ground. She faces almost directly forward, with her chin lifted a little and her eyes looking just past the viewer. A dark sweep of short hair crosses the forehead and falls around the temples; loose black lines continue outward from the crown into the surrounding field. The nose and lips are softly drawn, but the shadows under the eyes, along the jaw, and at the base of the neck are sharply darkened. Her upper body dissolves into a block of rough black marks at the lower right, leaving the left shoulder only partly suggested. The background consists of cream, gray, and tan paper areas overlaid with faint columns of printed type, narrow ruled lines, seams, scratches, and small fragments of handwriting. A muted brick-red patch fills part of the upper-left edge and brings a single warm color note into the largely grayscale image. The face itself is built through charcoal-like smudges, dry crosshatching, erased pale passages, and scratchy directional strokes. Some marks cut across the cheeks and neck rather than stopping neatly at the contour, binding the figure to the page beneath it. Illumination is implied through the light paper left open on the forehead, cheeks, and throat; dark marks supply the opposing shadow. The head sits near the center, cropped closely at the top, and the field of fragmented text remains visible around it. The overall effect is intimate and unsettled: a carefully observed human expression held inside a visibly layered, worked, and partially worn surface.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形混合媒介绘画让一名年轻女子的头肩从浅色、磨旧的纸底中浮现。她几乎正面朝前，微抬下巴，目光略越过观众。短发的一片深色发束扫过额头并落向鬓边；松散黑线从头顶继续向周围空间伸展。鼻子与嘴唇画得柔和，但眼下、下颌和颈根的阴影明显加深。上身在右下角溶入粗糙的黑色笔痕块，左肩只得到部分暗示。背景由奶油、灰和棕褐色纸面组成，上面叠着模糊的印刷文字列、细规线、接缝、擦痕及小段手写字迹。低饱和砖红色块占据左上边缘的一部分，为几乎全灰的画面带来唯一显著的暖色。面孔本身由炭笔般擦抹、干涩交叉排线、擦出的浅色区域和划动的方向性笔触建立。一些痕迹横过脸颊与颈部，并未工整地停在轮廓上，从而把人物与底下纸页联在一起。照明通过额头、脸颊与喉部保留的浅纸色暗示；深笔痕提供相对阴影。头部接近中央，在顶部紧密裁切，碎片化文字仍围绕其四周可见。整体效果亲密而不安：一个被认真观察的人类表情，留在可见层叠、反复加工并局部磨损的表面里。
style_prompt_en: Mixed-media drawing combines charcoal-like smudging, dry crosshatching, scratched lines, erasure, and faint printed-paper fragments. A restrained range of black, gray, cream, and tan gains a small muted red accent. Forms emerge through rough tonal accumulation rather than continuous clean contour; stray marks cross boundaries and connect the focal area to the surrounding surface. Ghosted text, ruled grids, visible seams, and abrasions make the ground feel found and worked. Light comes from reserved pale areas within the paper, countered by deep, expressive dark strokes. Close cropping and uneven texture create an intimate, raw, archival mood while preserving precise observation at the focal features.
style_prompt_zh: 混合媒介绘画结合炭笔般的擦抹、干涩交叉排线、划痕、擦除及模糊的印刷纸张碎片。克制的黑、灰、奶油和棕褐色系得到一小处暗红重音。形体靠粗糙色调积累浮现，而非连续干净的轮廓；游离笔痕越过边界，将焦点与周围表面连接。隐约文字、规线网格、可见接缝和磨损让底面像拾得并反复加工的材料。光来自纸面保留的浅色区域，与深而富于表现力的笔触相对。近景裁切与不均匀质地制造亲密、粗粝、带档案气息的情绪，同时让焦点部位保持准确观察。
theme_en: A woman's frontal face emerging from layered charcoal marks and old paper
theme_zh: 一张女子正面面孔从层叠炭笔痕与旧纸中浮现
name: Guy Denning
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
